title: Procedural Brep Playground
description: Extract brep kernel into @geometry/brep/js, setup @procedural/react flow-based brep editor with R3F viewport, and @procedural/play playground.
summary: Extracted cad-free @geometry/brep/js bundle (contracts, BrepjsGeometryKernel with sync eval, mesh helpers). Wired cad/js/core and cad/js/kernel/brepjs to import geometry contracts. Built @procedural/react (ProceduralEditor = FlowCanvas + brep JS flow module + BrepViewport R3F preview) and @procedural/play playground on port 6018. Extended FlowCanvas with onEvalOutputs. Registered procedural in framework renderer, vite aliases, launch.json, and root dev:procedural script. Tests pass for geometry/brep/js, procedural/react, procedural/play; dev server serves on http://127.0.0.1:6018/.
